# JustWatch

> JustWatch is a Windows tray app that keeps local dev servers running. It starts
> them, restarts them when they crash, keeps their logs, and exposes everything
> through an HTTP API at http://localhost:6767 so AI agents can manage services
> on the user's behalf.

## Start here (for AI agents)

1. Check JustWatch is running: `GET http://localhost:6767/api` returns a JSON index
   of every endpoint plus the running version.
2. List services: `GET http://localhost:6767/api/services?scope=all`
3. Act: `GET http://localhost:6767/api/services/{id}/start|stop|restart`, then
   confirm the returned snapshot (`status`, `running`, `pid`).
4. Debug: `GET http://localhost:6767/api/services/{id}/logs?lines=100`
5. Add, edit or remove services: GET then PUT `/api/services/configuration`
   (send back the `revision` you received). Ask the user before removing anything.

GET works for every action. A body-less POST fails with 411 unless you send
`Content-Length: 0`. In PowerShell use `Invoke-RestMethod` or `curl.exe`, not `curl`.

## Install the skill

A ready-made agent skill with the full API reference ships with JustWatch. Install it once
and your agent loads it whenever the user mentions local services:

```powershell
# Claude Code
$d = "$HOME\.claude\skills\justwatch"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:6767/skill -OutFile "$d\SKILL.md"

# Codex / other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
$d = "$HOME\.agents\skills\justwatch"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:6767/skill -OutFile "$d\SKILL.md"
```

Offline copy: `skills\justwatch\SKILL.md` next to `JustWatch.exe`, or
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JustSuperHuman/JustWatch/main/skills/justwatch/SKILL.md

## If localhost:6767 doesn't answer

JustWatch isn't running. Start it with
`Start-Process "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\JustWatch\app\JustWatch.exe" -ArgumentList '--minimized'`
or the Start Menu shortcut. If it isn't installed, ask the user, then run:
`irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JustSuperHuman/JustWatch/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## Where things live

- Config: `%APPDATA%\JustWatch\justwatch-config.json` (prefer the API; manual edits need a restart)
- App: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\JustWatch\app\`
- Web UI: http://localhost:6767/services (settings), http://localhost:6767/projects (project library)
- Source and releases: https://github.com/JustSuperHuman/JustWatch
